capabilities: Dispatch selected note text to a Claude Code skill via right-click context menu
Stream skill responses into a persistent side panel
Continue multi-turn conversations with follow-up questions
Run freeform chat from the ribbon icon or command palette
Export full conversation transcripts as vault notes
disambiguation: Does not create or manage Claude skills; it only dispatches selected text to skills already defined in ~/.claude/skills/.
extras: Desktop-only (uses Node.js child_process); on Linux the subprocess is wrapped in systemd-run --scope with IPAddressDeny=any for network isolation; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Using Claude Code skills normally means switching to a terminal; there is no way to invoke them on note text from inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that connects your notes to the Claude Code CLI.

requires.name: Claude Code CLI (claude binary on PATH)
Anthropic API usage (per-query spend cap configurable)

summary: AI bridge that sends selected note text to Claude Code CLI skills and streams responses into a persistent side panel.
